translation.name: Deus Harere Aibaky Sesus mymyspirikpoko naha

book.name: Mateus
book.title: Mateus wasaniha ty ziwatahaka Sesus soho

content: Myikaha abazuba soho humo nisihyrinymyryky.
Kyze Sesus usa soho nipamykysokozo Deus tyryktsa soho humo nisihyrinymyryky.
Hawa Deus kytsa nisiwatawy nisihyrinymyryky. Batu sizuba hyỹ maha ana humo hi nisihyrinymyryky. Kyze maku myhyrizikwanita tse myikaha inakymy. Itse isukzata humo myikaha zihitsa niy.
Kyze zihitsa sitsumuẽhĩtsitsa nisipeha — Kytsa tynasakzo! “Pany aidy botu nakymy ispe tsimaha” — niy. Iwaze nitururuknaha. Sakzohotsa batu yhỹ niaha.
Iwaze zihitsa ustsa mektsatu nasakzorenaha. Iharere tihi: — Panytaha! katse tasukzata pimyikahaka. Pikuzatsa botu nisibanaha — niy. Anaharere sitsumuẽhĩtsitsa nasiakzokonaha.
Anaharere bo batu mytsatyziu niaha. Estuba tatsuhuk bo niparak. Usta tanamy bo niparak.
Iwaze ustsa sitsasohotsitsa nisisukbatsinaha nisikikinaha. Nisibaiknaha.
Iwatahi zihitsa takyriki sodadutsa pe: — Kytsa sakzohotsa botaha niy! Asaktsa katsumuẽhĩtsa nisibanahatsa tysibaiknaktsa! Sihudikhudikwy tsipokiknahaktsa! — niy. Iwa hỹ.
Kyze zihitsa sitsasohokotsitsa hua huazo niy ispe niy: — Katse myikaha inakymy sakzohotsa batu sisopyksapy maha.
Abaka ske buruktaha! Nabo kytsa sihobykwy watu tysipehanaha niy. Ikiahatsa tihi: “Panytaha! Abazubata tse myikaha sukzawy humo panytaha! tsimaha” niy. Yhỹ niaha. Nasiakzobanaha.

Iwaze sitsasohokotsitsa ske buruk maha. Sizubarẽtsa zihobyknaha. Simysapyrẽtsa pe simysapybyitsa pe asa kino niwatihi imyikaha bo mysioktyhyryk. Hamyikaha bo inahareknaha sizubarẽtsa hỹ. — Anaeze tahadisahakanaha.

Kyze abazubata zihitsa inatsukze sakzohotsa bo iktsa niy. Iwa kytsa abazubata zihitsa sisuk humo nisisukba iwa sisopyk. Estuba maku batu, tasuk tyzuba korobyk niy, zihitsa suk humo batu hỹ niy. Iwaze zihitsa maku pe, atakta tasuk tyzuba korobyk.
— Hawa kamyikaha bo tsimy. Asukbyita tu mymyikaha bo tsiknatsuk — niy. Maku batu harere tisikpybyrẽta. Abazubata zihitsa suk batu yhỹ ana hi batu tyso.
Kyze abazubata zihitsa sitsumuẽhĩtsa pe: — Maku kasuk batu yhỹ atahi pipawarahiknaha! Ape bo miwaha bo typapykik nabo sinini my iwaze mopuziuku takyrikita tu tatsapu ty dydydy mykara — niy.

Kyze Sesus isoho nitsasoziuku. Atahi: — Deus zihitsa wata sizubarẽtsa mysiakzo ityryktsa moziknaha batu sizuba iharere bo hyỹ mykaranaha — niy. Asahi nisiwatawy. Batu sizuba iharere bo hyỹ mykaranaha.
Kytsa okyrysaro humo Sesa bo nyny mykaranaha ja.
Kyze wastuhu Pariseutsa ziponaha, asa zuba niaksohokiknaha. Tahatuktu nipamykysokonaha. — Sesus Moises harere bo batu yhỹ mozihikiknaha — iwa mytsaty nikaranaha.

Kyze ituktsa Erodes tuktsa kino niwatihi Sesus nizokparakanaha. Iharere humo batu imysapy mozihikiknaha ana humo hi Sesus bo zumukunaha. Asahi: — O myhyrinymyrykytsa tisapyrẽna haty zuba nisihyrinymyryky ana humo hi myhyrinymyrẽtsa. Kytsa pokso batu apyby. Kytsa abazubatsa humo batu asikpyby. Kytsa aharere siakparawy byizeka batu asikpyby. Moises harere tsinymyryziuku ahyrinymyrywy baba my.

Mypehatsa abazubata Sesa okyrysaro ja ibo nyny tsimaha. Katsaktsa Sudeutsa Moises harere bo yhỹ tsimykaranaha okyrysaro ty Homa abazubata nyny tsimaha zeka wasani ja. Ana soho humo ikia mytsaty tsimy — niaha.
Sesus simysapybyi humo tsihyrinymyrẽta hỹ. Ispe niy: — Ikiahatsa tawatahakanahatsa watsa. Amo kaharere humo uta imysapybara tsimyzihikiknaha ana hi tsipiperykynaha. Iwatatu ahape my:
Okyrysaro ty estuba kabo nynytaha! Atakta kytsa bo nyny tsimy — niy. Napiri wata ty estuba ibo nyny niaha.
— Aty naro sa okyrysaro humo ziwatahaka. Aty hyrikoso sa okyrysaro humo ziwatahaka — niy.

— Abazubata Sesa hyrikoso okyrysaro humo — niaha. Sesus ispe niy: — Niwazuba! Sesa namy ty ibo tu tysizotahaktsa! Deus mozihikik ana ty zuba Deus bo nyny tahaktsa! Deus hawa ha ty mozihikik ibo tysizotaha hỹ — niy.
Iharere humo sipybyrẽtsa. Iwaze nitururuknaha, Sesus ta zuba nitare.
Mynahyrizikpo naha soho Sesus nitsasoko.
Bykyze Sadusitsa Sesus bo zumunaha. Asahi. — Kytsa mohyrikosokdanahaze ba zikyrizikpozonaha — mykaranaha.

Iwatsahi Sesus pe: — O myhyrinymyrykytsa. Tubabatu Moises Deus harere botu ziwatahaka: “Maku ihyrytsa byitatu mohyrikosokda zeka itsy haramukuka piakse”. Iwaze atatsa tabykyhyze itse mopurukze kytsa tihi: “O izikytse mopuruk” maha — niy. Iwa Deus harere my.
— Kyze kytsa itukytsa sete niaha. Taparakta tasukza. Bykyze ihyrytsa byita tu nihyrikosokda.

Niytahi itsy haramukuka ziakse. Itsy kino ihyrytsa byita tu nihyrikosokda. Bykyze itsy taziky wanu sapy ziakse. Ihyrytsa byita tu ata kino nihyrikosokda. Kyze sete ahatsa astatsa tu ziakse. Estuba nihyrikosokdaze usta atatsa ziakse. Iwa kytsa sete itukytsa iwatsa niakbanaha. Itukytsa hyrytsa habyitsa tu niakbakanaha.
Iwaze atatsa kino niwatihi nihyrikosokda.
Kyze nawa puruze kytsa mynahyrizikponahaze aty sa atatsa barikta babata. Sete itukytsa ziaksenaha — niaha.
Kyze Sesus ispe niy: — Kytsa nahyrizikponaha soho batu ahahyrinymyry. Deus harere humo batu ahaspirikpo Deus zikwy batu ahanyhỹ.

Abaktsa kytsa zuba tahasukzanaha. Wytykyryk zioktyhyryknaha. Aparakbaha inahyrizikponahaze kytsa sisukzabyitsa, wytykyryk ba zitahapytsazonaha. Niwazuba! Bijoikpe iknyktsa Deus tsumuẽhĩtsitsa watsa moziknaha batu sisukza — niy.
— Kytsa inahyrizikponaha hawa ha ty Deus botu ziwatahaka batu ahahyrinymyry niy.

Deus tihi: “Utakta Deus, Abarão kahumo tispirikporẽta. Adiri Isake kahumo tispirikporẽta. Adiri Sako kahumo tispirikporẽta iwatsa. Aba kahumo sispirikporẽtsa.” Kytsa niakbanahatsa Deus humo batu sispirikpo. Iwatsahi mynahyrizikponaha Deus humo sispirikporẽtsa — Sesus niy.
Myzubaha ihyrinymyrywy ziwabynahaze sipybyrẽtsa maha.
Hawa ha sa Deus harere abazuba.
Kyze Pariseutsa ziwabynahaze hawa Sesus harere Sadusitsa bo niy. Nisiharere pykiknaha. Wastuhu Pariseutsa inakypyknahaze estuba Deus harere zihyrinymyryta Sesus imyiwy mozihikik iwatahi ipe niy:
— O myhyrinymyrytsa! Hawa ha sa Deus harere abazuba — niy.
Sesus tihi: — Deus humo ahamypokzitsirẽtsa babatsa. Iharere bo zuba ma tsimykaranaha! Ibo zuba mytsatyziuty! Itsyhyryze tarabajaziuba tsimykaranaha — niy.
— Ana harere hi abazuba my. Usa harere wasani ahaotuktsa pauktsitsa tynasipokzitsikinaha, ahumo tsinakara naha wa tihi taha.
Anaharere petoktsa abazubaha. Hawa ha ty Deus sohokotsa kytsa nisihyrinymyrykynaha hawa ha ty Moises harere ziwatahaka niwatihi anaharere petoktsa abazubaha humo my atsatu my — niy.
Deus zipehata soho niy.
Iwaze wastuhu Pariseutsa inakypykyknahaze.
Sesus ispe niy: — Deus zipehata aty sa itsekoka my. Aty soho sa mytsaty tsimaha — niy. — O Kiristu Deus zipehata Dawi tsekoka my — niaha.
Sesus: — Iwa zeka amy humo sa Dawi Deus hyrikoso humo ipe: “Kapehatsa.”
Dawi tihi: Deus hi Kiristu zipehata:

content.text: Bykyzehu utakta Deus asukyrytsitsa apyrytsa pukezi tysipykwy
iwatsahi asukyrytsitsa aharere bo hyỹ maha” niy — Dawi niy.

content: — Dawi Deus zipehata pe “Kapehatsa” batu itsekoka hawa Deus zipehata Dawi tsekoka. Atahi Dawi tsekoka ipehatsa niwatihi. Dawi nipurukze Deus zipehata koikny baktatu Deus tsekoka humo — niy.
Batu aty tohi ziky. Iharere myhyrinymyrykyta babata tuze batu aty tohi zikmypeha. Sisikpybyrẽtsa iwatsahi batu harere zikaha.
